# Architecture & Tech Stack
<!-- docs.AI knowledge doc — auto-generated by speckit.init -->

## Core Architecture

**Plugin-based skill system** — Each skill is a self-contained `SKILL.md` file (Markdown with YAML frontmatter). Skills are stateless, declarative instruction sets; no procedural code exists.

**Multi-model adapter architecture** — A single skill definition is referenced by three JSON adapters (`adapters/claude.json`, `adapters/codex.json`, `adapters/antigravity.json`) so the same skill runs on Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Antigravity without modification.

**Template-driven artifact generation** — Skills that produce output (spec, plan, tasks, etc.) resolve templates in this order:
1. `specs/.templates/<template-name>.md` (project custom — highest priority)
2. Prompt-provided inline template
3. `templates/<template-name>.md` (repo default — lowest priority)

**Stateful context via CLAUDE.md** — Per-project workflow rules, tracker credentials, and active iteration are stored in the project's `CLAUDE.md`. Skills read this at runtime.

## Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Skill definitions | Markdown + YAML frontmatter |
| Distribution config | JSON (plugin.json, adapters, marketplace.json) |
| Install scripts | Bash (`install.sh`) + PowerShell (`install.ps1`) |
| Primary runtime | Claude Code (MCP) |
| Secondary runtimes | OpenAI Codex CLI, Antigravity |
| Tracker APIs | Azure DevOps REST 7.1, Jira REST v3, GitHub gh CLI, Linear GraphQL, Notion REST |

## Key Patterns

- **Progressive disclosure**: SKILL.md frontmatter provides a short description; the full instruction body is the implementation.
- **Declarative skills**: Skills describe WHAT to do, not HOW to compute it — the AI model executes.
- **Tracer-bullet tasks**: Implementation tasks are always vertical slices (DB → API → UI), never horizontal layers.
- **Session-scoped feature pointer**: `specs/feature.json` tells all skills which feature directory is currently active.

## Constraints

- No build step, no runtime dependencies, no database.
- Skills are version-controlled alongside the project that installs them.
- Breaking changes require a major version bump (template format is frozen at v2.x).
